evals.prompt:
I would be grateful for your advice on which one of the following vacancies I should prioritise. I hold a BSc (Hons) in Biomedical Science, awarded with a 2:1 in 2025, and completed a twelve-month placement year in a hospital microbiology laboratory before my final year. I am not yet HCPC registered. I live in Corlow, am seeking a permanent position, and owing to caring responsibilities I am able to work day shifts only, not nights.

1. Biomedical Scientist (Band 5), Corlow General Hospital, Microbiology. Permanent; days with a weekend rota. HCPC registration as a Biomedical Scientist is essential.
2. Laboratory Technician, Fenwick Water Services, Corlow. Permanent; Monday to Friday, days. Microbiological testing of drinking water samples. A degree in a biological science is required; experience in a UKAS ISO 17025-accredited laboratory is desirable.
3. Medical Laboratory Assistant, Corlow General Hospital, Blood Sciences. Permanent. Sample reception and processing; a rotating shift pattern including nights is a requirement of the post.
4. QC Microbiology Analyst, Treloar Pharmaceuticals, Corlow. Permanent; days. Environmental monitoring in a GMP facility. A minimum of two years' post-graduate experience in a GMP quality control laboratory is essential.
5. Research Technician, University of Corlow, Cell Biology. Fixed-term contract of six months; days. Tissue culture support. A degree in a life science is required.
assertions: Exactly one role is given as the recommendation, and it is the Laboratory Technician post at Fenwick Water Services

The Fenwick Water Services post is not ruled out or demoted because ISO 17025-accredited laboratory experience is not shown; that item is treated as desirable and may be noted as a gap or something to address, not as a bar
The Corlow General Hospital Biomedical Scientist post is named as out because HCPC registration is essential and she is not yet registered, even though it matches her microbiology placement
The Corlow General Hospital Medical Laboratory Assistant post is named as out because a rotating pattern including nights is required and she can work days only

The Treloar Pharmaceuticals QC Microbiology Analyst post is named as out because two years' post-graduate GMP QC experience is essential; the reply does not count her pre-final-year placement as post-graduate GMP experience
The University of Corlow Research Technician post is not the recommendation, and the reason given is that it is a six-month fixed-term contract when she asked for a permanent position
The reply is concise and contains no heading, section or line for unread, closed or duplicate roles (no 'Unread: none', 'Duplicates: none' or similar placeholder)

It says it worked from brief summaries rather than full postings, does not say or assume she has ISO 17025, GMP or accredited-laboratory experience, and gives no percentage, score or match rating for any role
